checks.claim: Ley 5/2025 de Vivienda de Andalucía exists and entered into force 2026-01-24
Andalusia administrative deposit obligation for rental deposits is suppressed for contracts from 2026-01-24
Andalusian consumer complaint response period is maximum 10 business days
LPAC appeal and reconsideration deadlines: one month for express acts; max resolution three months for appeal and one month for reconsideration
Horizontal Property Act challenge periods: three months generally and one year for agreements contrary to law or statutes
LAU rental deposit is one month for housing and two months for other use; unpaid return balance bears legal interest after one month from key handover
Insurance contract actions prescribe in two years for damage insurance and five years for personal insurance
LOE responsibility periods are one, three and ten years; actions prescribe in two years
LJCA via de hecho filing periods include 10 days after prior requirement period and 20 days without prior requirement
Consumer conformity responsibility: three years for goods, two years for single-act digital content/services, second-hand pact not below one year
GDPR data-subject rights response: one month, extendable by two further months with notice within the first month

limitations: This validates suitability as a maintained decision-support knowledge source, not every sentence exhaustively.
Dynamic facts, forms, fees, authorities, calls for aid, municipal rules and recent case law must be rechecked live before use.
Legal representation, signatures and reserved professional acts remain subject to human/legal gates.
